01 Capability Statement

A government-first technology firm engineered for the demands of federal, state, and municipal programs. We deliver from concept through operation without handing your program to a bench.

For Prime Contractors

Sub-contracting partner with domain fluency across FEMA, DHS, USAID, and public health portfolios. Cleared personnel, documented process, teaming agreements available on request.

For Contracting Officers

Direct-award ready across multiple vehicles. Compliance-first architecture, security posture documented from day one, and a delivery record built on scoped increments rather than promises.

ICapabilities

Six disciplines, one connected practice.

Every engagement draws from the same underlying practice, whether the work is a single integration or a multi-year modernization program.

Fig. 01

Systems

Architecture, modernization, integration, optimization, and enterprise technology infrastructure built to hold up under real operational load.

Software

Custom software engineering, digital platforms, applications, and APIs built for mission-specific requirements rather than generic templates.

Data

Database architecture, analytics, intelligence, visualization, and reporting that turn raw information into decisions people can act on.

Cloud

Cloud architecture, migration, infrastructure, and modernization planned around the constraints public sector environments actually operate under.

Automation

Intelligent workflows, process automation, and system integration that remove manual work without removing accountability.

Delivery

Program management, technology implementation, and financial systems support that carry a project from award to operation.

IIAI

Empowered by AI. Accountable to people.

We put AI to work where it measurably improves a program, and keep people, auditability, and security in charge of every decision it touches.

Intelligent automation

Document intake, case triage, and routine processing handled by AI, so program staff spend their time on the work that needs judgment.

Decision support

Models and analytics that surface risk, demand, and anomalies early, with the reasoning visible to the people who act on it.

AI assistants

Search, summarization, and drafting tools grounded in your own policies and records, deployed inside your security boundary.

AI-accelerated delivery

Modern AI tooling across our own engineering, so modernization and testing move faster without lowering the bar on review.

Responsible AI

Model documentation, bias and performance testing, and human-in-the-loop controls, built around frameworks such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
